parsed_response.reasoning: The new template group_member.hbs uses `{{#unless automatic}}`, but it's the per-member itemView rendered for each Discourse.User via `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}` in group.hbs. Nothing in the diff passes the group's `automatic` flag down to the view or member context, and `automatic` is a group attribute, not a user attribute — so the guard resolves against the member and the remove link renders regardless of group type. Meanwhile group.hbs gates the addMembers section with `{{#unless automatic}}` but does NOT gate the members list itself, so for automatic groups (which have ids and members) the per-member remove link appears; the backend rejects the removal with 422 (add_members/remove_member specs show automatic groups return 422), so the UI shows a broken-action link. The mechanism is verifiable from the diff: the flag is never propagated to the itemView context.

judged_text: app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group_member.hbs:1 — `{{#unless automatic}}` in this per-member itemView template resolves `automatic` against the member (User) context, not the group, so the remove-member link renders unconditionally (including for automatic groups' members) even though group.hbs correctly gates the group-level UI on the group's `automatic` flag, an inconsistent sibling-flag-propagation gap.

adjudication.rationale: In `group.hbs` the member list is rendered via `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}`, and the new `group-member` view (`admin/views/group-member.js.es6`) defines no bindings/aliases to expose the parent group’s `automatic` flag. Yet `admin/templates/group_member.hbs` uses `{{#unless automatic}}...{{/unless}}` to decide whether to show the remove link. From the diff alone, `automatic` is not provided on the per-item view/context, so it will resolve as undefined/falsey and the `unless` block will render, showing the remove link even for automatic groups (leading to inconsistent UI and likely 422s from `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member`).
